# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 25 (Bu-Vb Pc25)
**ID:** Bu-Vb Pc25
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 25
**Title (English, from literature):** Giving robe-cloth to a nun

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Cīvaradānasikkhāpada* (Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 25) is a training rule in the Vinaya Piṭaka regulating monks' transactions of robe-cloth with nuns [SuttaCentral; Hüsken 1997]. The rule specifies that a monk commits an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*) if he gives robe-cloth to a bhikkhunī who is not related to him, unless it is in exchange (*aññatra pārivattakā*) [SuttaCentral; Hüsken 1997]. In the commentary (*Samantapāsādikā*), it is noted that this rule is the counterpart to Nissaggiya Pācittiya 5 (receiving robe-cloth from an unrelated nun), differing principally in that here the nun is the recipient rather than the monk [Hüsken 1997].
The rule has broad parallels across all major surviving Vinaya traditions. Curated parallels include the corresponding rule in the Pali *Bhikkhu Pātimokkha* (Pācittiya 25) and *Bhikkhu Parivāra* (Pācittiya 25), as well as Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga and Prātimokṣa parallels preserved in Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mahāsāṅghika, Dharmaguptaka, Kāśyapīya, and Lokottaravāda recensions in Chinese, Sanskrit, and Tibetan [SuttaCentral]. In Dharmanexus text-reuse analysis, the passage exhibits significant internal phrasing parallels with related Vinaya rules, especially Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 5 (§1.16–3.1.12), Pācittiya 26 (§3.1.12–3.3.11), and Nissaggiya Pācittiya 4, alongside Khandhaka formulations [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns the rule with Sanskrit and Tibetan Vinaya commentaries and Prātimokṣasūtra texts, including the Tibetan translation of the *Bhikṣuṇīvinayavibhaṅga* (D0005) and commentaries on the Prātimokṣasūtra (D4104, D4108, D4106-2) [DharmaNexus]. An English translation of the Pali text has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
